title: Claude Reel 1 - I copied the experts. I sold nothing.
subtitle: Instagram version (comment PERFECT) · style: Halftone Dossier
hook: I Copied The Experts. / Sold NOTHING.
thumbText: I Copied EXPERTS. Sold Zero. (+ GURU A / COACH B / EXPERT C = 0 sales, hand-drawn circle + arrow, "all borrowed.")
linkNote: Ends with: comment PERFECT and I'll send it to you (Instagram). Other platforms: asheraw.com/link, which has a tab linking to https://asheraw.com/blog/the-perfect-offer-doesnt-exist-until (other-platforms version not made yet).

checklist.t: Thumbnail is frame 0 of the video (2 frames), for platforms with no custom thumbnail upload
Starts with you in full view, then a swift push-down (at 0.7 s) into the lower window
Your cap/head pops out above the window border (cut-out of you, Kallaway style)
Hook text at the very top (unsafe zone) the whole video, 2 lines, one gold keyword
Colour grade A applied to you only (warmer skin, deeper blacks); the panel is untouched
Safe zones: captions and panel text sit inside x130-940 / y250-1436. Tick the 'show safe zones' box to check. The panel's gold frame edge is slightly wider (decorative)
Captions: 3 words max, sentence case, only the keyword in CAPS + gold; spelling follows what you said (script says 'believe', you said 'believed')
Length 68.6 s, under the 90 s Reel limit (speed 1.1x, dead air trimmed)
Loudness -14.4 LUFS; music 'Miami - Lofive' ducked under your voice; no marker/eraser sounds
Warm-up ('warm, warm, warm') and your two flubbed endings are cut out
Ending sentence is spliced: 'if you want the full article, more training and my prompts,' + 'comment PERFECT and I'll send it to you.' (from two takes). Please listen to check it sounds natural
Other-platforms version (asheraw.com/link ending): not made yet. Your take 'asheroll.com' was a mispronunciation, so that ending needs a splice or a re-record
Pop-out edge quality: the black cap crown blends into the dark background; I added a faint warm glow behind your head so it reads

scenes.label: Frame 0 = thumbnail
scenes.note: Thumbnail image for 2 frames, then you in full view.

scenes.label: Push-down
scenes.note: You slide down to the lower window; the panel is revealed; the hook stays on top.

scenes.label: I copied the experts. I sold nothing.
scenes.note: Case file opens: 'I COPIED THE EXPERTS', stamp SOLD NOTHING, copies sold: 0.

scenes.label: 15 years, learned from experts
scenes.note: Six expert figures appear one by one; 'learned from all of them'.

scenes.label: Stitched into one offer
scenes.note: Four patches (headline, modules, bonus, pricing) from different gurus, stitched with a red dashed seam into 'MY OFFER v1.0'.

scenes.label: Every part in place... nobody bought it
scenes.note: Checklist ticks off 5 parts; buyers: 0; stamp NOBODY BOUGHT.

scenes.label: So I did what they said
scenes.note: Their steps / modules / bonuses copied one-to-one into mine.

scenes.label: Part by part
scenes.note: Each part of my offer gets a yellow name tag of the expert behind it; 'parts from me: 0'; stamp NOT ONE FROM ME.

scenes.label: The colleague who repeats the boss
scenes.note: Boss says a line, colleague echoes it; 'nobody asks them anything'.

scenes.label: Buyers can't find you in it
scenes.note: Search box 'who is behind this offer?' -> 0 RESULTS.

scenes.label: This is the Source Check
scenes.note: Title card: THE SOURCE CHECK, stamp DO THIS.

scenes.label: Point at each part, ask where it came from
scenes.note: A magnifier moves down the parts; 'WHERE DID THIS COME FROM?'.

scenes.label: Swap someone else's name
scenes.note: 'GURU A' struck out, replaced by three cards: I BELIEVE / I LIVED / I DID.

scenes.label: Want the full file?
scenes.note: Article folder + MORE TRAINING + MY PROMPTS tickets.

scenes.label: Comment PERFECT
scenes.note: End card: COMMENT PERFECT and I'll send it to you.
